description: Estimate the next Mercedes-Benz service (alternating Service A/B, ASSYST-style) from the last service type, date and mileage. Default interval: 15,000 km or 12 months, whichever comes first.

current_km.description: Current odometer reading in km (optional; improves the estimate)

last_service_date.description: Date of the last service, YYYY-MM-DD

last_service_km.description: Odometer reading at the last service, in km

last_service_type.description: Type of the last service: A or B

name: get_next_service
